notes: SwiftPM T2 with Swift 6.2.1. Use a local Swift toolchain with XCTest or set BGRAPH_SWIFT_IMAGE=swift@sha256:0e4716bd34384d22963a63afbdbc93be3129dfd0753185aa1ded27755abdcae8 (Linux arm64). The pinned suites use XCTest. Two full-suite baselines establish the portable test census and baseline failures, then run the whole XCTest suite for every mutant and confirm red targets in a second whole-suite run. Tries is the fixed number of sampled one-token operator mutations per repository. The builds reuse a separate scratch directory for each repository. The generated manifests and raw suite reports live beside the cached oracle. Swift Numerics provides a two-target, statically enumerable control alongside two five-or-more-target opaque packages.
